subject: Pilot with Redwood Inference — timing check
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@gridfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, May 01, 2025 at 3:12 PM -0700
Subject: Pilot with Redwood Inference — timing check

Hi Elena — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap (from my notes):
- Goal: Reduce inference cost for your customer-facing summarization pipeline by ~40% while keeping latency under 200ms p95.
- Primary constraints: PCI-scope data path, single-region deployment in us-west, 30k tokens/day steady-state.
- Success metric: match current quality on our eval set and achieve 35–45% cost reduction in production traffic.

Suggested pilot (attached): redwood-pilot-outline.pdf
- 2-week evaluation on a subset of traffic (staging mirror)
- Dedicated capacity, quantization profile tuned for model X
- Joint validation and QA run, then production smoke test

Can you confirm: (a) whether priority is still Q2 for this work and (b) which week would be best to start the pilot (we have open windows May 19–23 or June 2–6)?

If it helps, Marissa (cc’d) can jump into a short kickoff to walk security and infra teams through the plan.

Thanks — I’ll hold the May 19 slot tentatively for GridFin if you want to lock it.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

Attachment: redwood-pilot-outline.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB)
From: Elena Morales <elena@gridfin.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kevin Luo <kevin@gridfin.com>
Date: Fri, May 02, 2025 at 10:05 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot with Redwood Inference — timing check

Hi Michael — appreciate the summary. Looks promising. A few quick things from our side: 

- We are interested but procurement wants a sense of price/commit and whether Redwood can sign our standard MSA.
- Security will ask for SOC 2 and an overview of data retention/audit logs. Can you send a short SOC 2 summary?
- On timing: May 19–23 would be tight for our infra team; June 2–6 is more realistic.

Kevin (cc’d) is the technical lead; I’ll connect him to your kickoff if we move forward.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
VP, Platform Engineering — GridFin
elena@gridfin.com
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@gridfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, May 07, 2025 at 9:38 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot with Redwood Inference — timing check

Elena — thanks for the quick reply.

Attached: pilot-scope.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Short answers: 
- Pricing/commit: For a 2-week pilot we typically provide a sandbox at no charge and apply trial credits for production smoke. Post-pilot we’ll propose a short-term committed Dedicated bench (monthly commit) that maps to the projected throughput; I’ve included a baseline estimate in the attached pilot-scope.xlsx.
- MSA: We can review your MSA — Marissa can lead that thread and surface any narrow exceptions.
- SOC 2: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf attached and full report available under NDA (link in related links).

Next steps I recommend: 
1) Confirm pilot start: propose June 2 or June 9 — which works better for your infra team?
2) If yes, sign a short SOW to lock the sandbox and assign engineering time.
3) Schedule 30-min kickoff with Kevin + our infra lead (Priya) the week before the start.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll assume timing has shifted and follow up in two weeks.

Best,
Michael
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pilot-scope.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 24KB)
Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 95KB)
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@gridfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, May 14, 2025 at 9:03 AM -0700
Subject: Final ping — archive or pick a date?

Hi Elena — hope you’re well. Quick follow-up since I haven’t heard back on dates/next steps. I know timelines move fast — two options so I don’t keep bothering you: 

Option A — Still interested: reply with which kickoff week works (June 2 or June 9) and we’ll send an SOW + calendar invite. We’ll also hold trial credits aside for GridFin.

Option B — Not now: reply “pause” and I’ll archive the opportunity on our side and check back in Q3.

Either response is totally fine — just want to align our plans so we’re not holding resources unnecessarily. If useful I can also hop on a 10-minute call to unblock anything specific.

Thanks for letting me know either way.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
If I don’t hear back by EOD next Thursday I’ll mark this as paused and reach back out in July.
